entries.rechecked_conclusion: The source reports disagreement and asks for versions; it supplies no delay, rework, wrong labeling or blockage. The old MEDIUM wording could admit clarification alone. The TL explicitly withholds supersession and asks for evidence, supporting procedural guidance rather than a decision on precedence. These are assisted interpretations, not fixed expected labels.

M05 asks whether to Quarantine; the reply gives playback reporting/do-not-score guidance without an explicit Quarantine decision. Its related guidance should not automatically imply complete resolution. M06 asks the broader player-versus-Quarantine alternative and can support a different scope assessment. E015 and E019 are different original members, so the old one-thread contrast is inaccurate; multiple items from either source must not inflate the new export count.

review_policy: Evaluate new actual responses without requiring predetermined severity/resolution labels; valid UNKNOWN/OPEN/PARTIAL and inherited/HIGH obligations are acceptable.
